meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用后,插件会自动运行 comment-checker;若报出警告,Codex 收到阻塞性反馈,需先修复或解释被标记的注释才能继续。
howto.when: apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具调用成功后自动触发;非编辑类工具被忽略,缺少检查器二进制时不输出任何内容。

say.text: comment-checker 报了警告,帮我修复被标记的那条注释
say.note: Codex 会先处理该注释再继续

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么被判为警告
say.note: Codex 给出解释而不直接改动

say.text: patch 后收到 comment-checker 反馈,告诉我下一步怎么做
say.note: Codex 按反馈说明后续动作

howto.what_en: After Codex succeeds with apply_patch, write, edit and similar edit calls, the plugin runs comment-checker; if it warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically after successful edit-like tool calls such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc. Non-edit tools are ignored, and no output appears when the checker binary is missing.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a warning — fix the flagged comment
Explain why this comment was flagged as a warning
I got comment-checker feedback after a patch — what next?
